Markets.title: Solar Industries’ defence share may fall to 22-25% by FY30 after Omnia deal: Jefferies
Markets.summary: Solar Industries' acquisition of Omnia will likely reduce its defence segment's revenue share to 22-25% by FY30 while boosting agriculture and explosives. Markets.title: UPI MDR explained for investors: How will new charges impact your mutual fund SIPs and stock investments?
Markets.summary: Starting October 15, a new Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) will apply to certain UPI merchant payments exceeding Rs 2,000, while mutual funds and capital-market transactions will incur a lower fee. Although merchants will bear the charge rather than customers, investors are questioning how this will affect stock investments and mutual fund SIPs.
